architecture_rule: Oblivion Findings is one operating organisation with multiple Sites. Bounded static page ownership does not establish Site access, roles or permissions, canonical ownership, direct-object concealment, privacy, lifecycle, runtime, or release readiness.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Create, review, and release legal holds
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The complete page only reviews, updates, and releases one legal hold, and the exact edit action renders that same lifecycle surface.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Create, list, remove, and timestamp trigger attempts for user-owned personal calendar connection metadata.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The page and controller exclusively create the authenticated user's personal calendar connection metadata, distinct from approved-Site resource integration.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Review and export Site, facility, checklist, and vendor reports
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The dedicated page reviews and filters overdue Site corrective-action reporting and has one exact SiteReportingController render owner.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Create and maintain a candidate, move or reject applications, manage the talent pool, communications, tags, and candidate documents.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The complete page gathers candidate and application data and the controller creates both records for the candidate-application lifecycle.

overlay_source_records.user_job: View and export authorised fleet report variants
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The page generates and exports the dated mileage-reimbursement report and depends on the matching Fleet report data action.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Create, update, activate, and run clinical protocols
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The dedicated create-protocol page and its material ProtocolForm implement the create portion of the clinical protocol lifecycle.

overlay_source_records.user_job: View the authorised live device map and its device projection
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The page is the authorised Control Room device-signal projection and explicitly separates canonical inventory ownership from this live-map journey.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Review and export Site, facility, checklist, and vendor reports
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The dedicated checklist-failure report and its controller aggregation own the checklist-report portion of Site reporting.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Check in, extend, govern, and discharge a respite stay
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The page is the stay-lifecycle register for active and completed respite stays and opens the canonical stay record.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Create, activate, start, advance, and skip alert playbooks
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The playbook detail/editor page reviews lifecycle state, evidence configuration, steps, and run history, with its wizard persisting create and update semantics.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Create, update, and advance pharmacy orders
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The prescriptions workbench and material dialogs implement prescriber, countersign, dispense, link, confirm, and cancel pharmacy-order actions.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Find, inspect, assign, watch, split, and report authorised tasks across canonical providers
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The complete cross-provider All Tasks workbench owns search, filtering, export, saved views, assignment, preview, statistics, and canonical deep links.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Manage confidential HR casework
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The confidential HR case detail page is the substantive facts, people, timeline, incident, disciplinary, stage, and closure workspace.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Create, progress, block, complete, and escalate governance actions
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The governance action detail page directly presents and completes one action item under the canonical action-item workflow.

overlay_source_records.user_job: View the authorised live device map and its device projection
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The page owns the Control Room signal-source/device projection while explicitly preserving canonical device inventory in Security and Devices.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Review and plan a Site roster, calendar, conflicts, coverage, and open shifts.
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The complete roster-planning workspace owns Site, staff, client, week, grid, conflict, coverage, leave, capacity, template, series, publish, and scheduling operations.

overlay_source_records.user_job: View and export authorised fleet report variants
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The dedicated Fleet by-house page substantively reports vehicle usage, trips, distance, fuel, transport, and cross-house comparisons.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Create, assess, review, and approve privacy impact assessments
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The DPIA edit page owns the assessment and editing portion of the privacy-impact lifecycle, including purpose, legal basis, subjects, risks, mitigations, levels, and review date.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Review and export Site, facility, checklist, and vendor reports
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The dedicated Site-detail report aggregates hazard, checklist, inspection, credential, and audit-log reporting under the Site reporting job.

overlay_source_records.user_job: Review and export Site, facility, checklist, and vendor reports
overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The dedicated Site asset-condition report owns Site filtering, condition groups, warranty summaries, and asset detail reporting.

reviewed_non_owner_outcomes.rationale: The thin event-detail shell imports a shared EventDetailDialog and the canonical matrix assigns this exact page to event closure, handover, investigation, WorkSafe, and register-related jobs.
review_discrepancies: Complete-page and matrix review rejects the packet's singleton projection as a multi-feature shared relation.

reviewed_non_owner_outcomes.rationale: The ActionItem list is semantically plausible, but its material generated showAction import is absent at the pinned application commit and build resolution was not executed, so sole page ownership cannot close.
review_discrepancies: RUN-105's condensed page graph omits the pinned unresolved generated import; the record remains tagged within the residual.

reviewed_non_owner_outcomes.rationale: The conflict workspace directly implements roster planning, shift cover, shift lifecycle, and staff-assignment actions, so it cannot be a one-feature page owner.
review_discrepancies: Complete-page review rejects the packet's singleton projection as a multi-feature shared relation.

reviewed_non_owner_outcomes.rationale: The same ticket page intentionally implements requester self-service and internal agent triage, assignment, resolution, merge, close, watch, reopen, and rating workflows.
review_discrepancies: The canonical matrix explicitly assigns this page to both self-service and agent-ticket features.
